status: Community outfitting data, not Frontier server source. Source values and derived capacity are separate from project adaptations.
limits: Snapshot covers 47 outfittable ships; absent announced craft, fighters, capital/alien/utility craft are not proved nonexistent.
Base shield strength, speed and rotation are hull calculation inputs, not a measured fully fitted/engineered result.
Maximum cargo ceiling fills all unrestricted optional slots with racks, removing shield/other optional gear; restricted slots excluded.
Default equipment differs from a maximum loadout. Missile ammunition belongs to the installed rack, not a fixed hull-wide count.
ED-LIVE snapshot must not silently overwrite ED-LEGACY or historical data.
Damage, heat, draw, cadence, ammo and FSD parameters are retained in modules. Final behaviour also depends on fitted mass, pips, engineering, resistance and engine equations.
